vector_db_chunks.text: The National Government Services Portal's Uttar Pradesh caste certificate listing states that residents belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), and Other Backward Classes (OBC) can apply for a caste certificate. This describes the categories named by that service listing and is not a determination of an individual's status or entitlement.

metadata.section: Categories named by official service listing
metadata.department: National Government Services Portal, Government of India
metadata.verification_note: The Government Services Portal listing names SC, ST and OBC applicants. This does not establish detailed category rules or individual eligibility. Checked 2026-10-22.

vector_db_chunks.text: A Uttar Pradesh district administration service page lists these supporting documents for a caste certificate application: self-declaration, a caste certificate/recommendation from the ward member or Gram Pradhan, and a photocopy of the ration card. District pages may not establish every applicant's accepted alternatives or current application-specific checklist, so confirm the live checklist on the eDistrict UP portal before applying. The source does not establish the fee.

metadata.verification_note: Both linked district NIC service pages list the same three document categories; neither establishes the currently payable fee. Checked 2026-10-21.

vector_db_chunks.text: Service: Caste Certificate (जाति प्रमाण-पत्र), Uttar Pradesh. Issued via eDistrict UP portal (https://edistrict.up.gov.in). Mandatory ₹30 fee. Requires Aadhaar e-KYC authentication.
Eligibility for Caste Certificate (UP): Applicant must belong to SC, ST, or OBC. (आवेदक SC, ST, या OBC से होना चाहिए). Available in State (UP) and Central format.

Required Documents for Caste Certificate (UP): 1. Applicant Photograph (आवेदक का फोटो) 2. Self-Certified Declaration Form (स्वप्रमाणित घोषणा पत्र) 3. Caste Proof Recommendation (पार्षद/वार्डन/ग्राम प्रधान का जाति के बाबत प्रमाण पत्र) 4. Residence and Identity Proof (राशन कार्ड की छाया प्रति अथवा बिजली का बिल अथवा कोई भी पते का प्रमाण पत्र).
